thread:
emily: Heads up — spotted two issues in the API reference snippets for /generate. JS SDK example shows literal escaped newlines (\\n) instead of actual newlines after the site build, and one of the response examples contains "choices": null which should be an empty array per the new response schema. Can someone own a quick fix?

emily: Broken JS snippet pasted from the page:
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "redwood-alpha",
  prompt: "Line1\\nLine2",
});
console.log(res.output[0].text);
```

emily: Bad response example in the doc page:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_abc",
  "object": "generation",
  "choices": null,
  "output": [ { "id": "o1", "text": "Hello" } ]
}
```

matt: Repro'd locally. Looks like the docs generator JSON-encodes examples for the JS snippets which turns newline chars into \\n sequences when rendered inside fenced blocks. Also the examples generator hasn't been updated to the response schema change (choices -> array). I'll open a small PR to fix the template and update examples across endpoints.

hugo: Do we know if that generator change will affect the SDK snippet extraction for python/go? Last time a template tweak cascaded into the sdk snippets.

matt: Good call. I'll make the change in a way that only affects the docs rendering layer (docs/examples/*.tmpl) and add a unit test that renders both the JS and python snippets. Should avoid touching the SDK generator.

matt: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — fixes JS escaping, normalizes response examples (null -> []), and adds a rendering test. CI preview should show the rendered page.

ci-bot: Preview ready — https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/preview/1234. Quick note: JS looks fixed, but curl examples still show \\\n in the JSON body on the preview page (curl code block appears to double-escape).

laura: Curl snippets are using inline JSON with surrounding backticks which go through an additional layer of escaping in our markdown pipeline. For curl examples we should switch to a heredoc-style snippet or a separate JSON asset so the pipeline doesn't JSON.stringify it. I'll push a small change to the PR to adjust the curl examples.

oliver: Suggestion: add a smoke test that fetches the built HTML and asserts that the generated code blocks don't contain \\n sequences for common patterns ("\\n", "\\t"). That will catch regressions earlier.

matt: Added the curl fix and the HTML smoke test to the PR. Also updated all generated response examples to use "choices": [] where appropriate. CI is running again.

ci-bot: CI passed ✅ — staging preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/preview/1234 (curl + JS + response examples look good).

emily: Thanks everyone — merged and backported to release/v1.3 (issue #879 resolved). Leaving a note in the migration guide that older docs might show "choices: null" and to regenerate if you vendor examples. :tada:

laura: Nice. Filed a follow-up to add an explicit docs lint rule for example shapes so we don't regress.

matt: Closing this thread after the backport. If anyone sees stray escaped sequences, ping me and I'll track it down.
